title: Microsoft unveils Surface Go to take on iPad
text: Microsoft unveils Surface Go to take on iPad Tuesday, 10 July 2018 ( 2 hours ago ) Microsoft is taking a stab at the cheap tablet market with the Surface Go, a 10-inch iPad competitor. ▶ Microsoft's $400 Surface Tablet, Taking On iPad And MacBook Air 00:38 Microsoft AAPL Apple 190.58 2.61 (+1.40 %) Disclaimer Get real-time AAPL charts here " MSFT Microsoft 101.85 0.69 (+0.70 %) Disclaimer Get real-time MSFT charts here " The Microsoft Surface Go is a teeny-tiny laptop/tablet hybrid with a 10-inch screen, clocking in at just 1.15 pounds.
